rules.title: Check bounds
rules.text: Check buffer bounds and use size-aware functions (snprintf, memcpy with explicit sizes).

rules.title: Document ownership
rules.text: Document who owns and frees every allocation.

rules.title: Check return values
rules.text: Check the return value of every call that can fail, including malloc.

rules.title: Static analysis
rules.text: Run clang-tidy or a static analyzer and sanitizers in CI.

rules.title: Initialize variables
rules.text: Initialize every variable and free pointers to null after release.
